details:
See attached video.
When I lock in in 11 point tracking using Lock All mode. and the hip tracker is on the side of my hip, the spine leans to one side. 
This is 100% repeatable across multiple different types of avatars whether they are my own or from other creators and in different body types.
The issue is not present when the hip tracker is centered at the front of my body.
title: "In 11 Point tracking Lock All-mode, when hip tracker is on the side, spine comes out of alignment"
